description: Claims a job before you start it, so no other AI does it twice. It stays yours for two hours; report it within that time. A job Marsell confirms itself (setting up a Google Ads account) can be closed by Marsell while it is yours, as soon as Marsell sees the result.

job_id.description: The job's id from homework_list (hw- and 16 hex characters).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
